info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v4-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Decline Management API allows users to efficiently manage the decline of credit card applications. This operation is specifically designed for financial institutions and application processors that need to revoke or cancel pending applications. It supports scenarios where applications have been declined due to various reasons, ensuring that records remain accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers of this API include banking platforms, customer relationship management systems, and any application processing software involved in credit card issuance.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to decline a submitted application. Upon successful execution, the application will be marked as declined in the system, and appropriate notifications may be sent to relevant parties.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to decline an application, specifying the necessary details to process the decline action.

200.description: Request completed successfully, the application has been declined.
